column3: Protocol, codecs and transports.
Server core: commands, player management, tick, limits, chunks, input validation, backups.
Player: game modes, health, hunger, effects, experience, death, armour, combat, projectiles, fishing, advancements.
Items and blocks in the game: item data, building, farming, signs, frames, maps.
Machines and containers: furnaces, hoppers, anvil, enchanting, stonecutter, backpack, crafting.
Signal dust: circuits, pistons, hoppers, readers, traps, note block.
Minecarts, rails and boats.
Creatures: behaviour, paths, crowds, bodies, single kinds.
Spawning and taming: spawning, spawners, golems, animals, pets.
World events: explosions, fire, weather, the void, slippery ground.
Villages: generation (qc_worldgen) and village life, trading (qc_server).
Meshing of chunks and entities, figures.
Rendering on the GPU: frame plan, buffers, arena, light, shadows, post-processing, sky, shaders.
Textures, atlas, texture packs, icons.
Client session: tick, prediction, reconciliation, interpolation, light, weather, maps, the session's sound.
Input: gamepad, key bindings, mouse, camera.
Controllers and models of the screens: admin, advancements, character, chat, inventory, maps, worlds.
User interface in general: building blocks, settings, scale, colours, enums.
Terrain: noise, climate, biomes, rivers, liquids, vegetation, ores, generator versions, world types.
Structures of the generation: temples, dungeons, mineshafts, towers, ruins, buildings.
The showcase world.
Saving: chunk store, world files, world library, block and entity data.
